# Get Last Bursts

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the last n bursts you took.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getLastBurst(count: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getLastBurst(count: 1)
~~~~
